# `aitbc market payment`

Show the coordinator payment record for a job or payment ID. Read-only view of the coordinator's ``job_payments`` ledger. The API scopes the read to the caller's own jobs — a 403 means the stored client credential does not own this job, not that the payment is missing.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market payment [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Coordinator job ID |
| `--payment-id` | text | — | no | Payment record ID |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market payment
```
